title: OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY_PIN -- the owner trust root (GATE 1A.2 section 3)
description: The production verifier reads the owner public key from EXACTLY ONE fixed path: trust/OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY_PIN.json. It accepts no --pinned-pubkey-hex argument, no caller-supplied key bytes, no key embedded only in the approval under verification, and no environment-variable substitute. Until the owner replaces the deliberately-invalid template (status OWNER_KEY_NOT_YET_PINNED) in a later owner-controlled pin commit, every production verification returns OWNER_KEY_NOT_PINNED. Test fixtures live only under tests/fixtures/ with key ids prefixed TEST- and are refused in production mode by key id. The owner PRIVATE key never exists in this repository or any machine Claude operates.

key_id.description: owner-chosen key identifier; MUST NOT start with 'TEST-' (that prefix is reserved for non-claim-bearing fixtures and is refused in production)

pinned_by.description: the owner's name/handle; the pin commit itself is the authorization record

non_claim_bearing.description: production pins are claim-bearing infrastructure; fixtures set true and are refused in production
